challenge_simulator.risk_cap: Skip an entry if total active stop-risk would exceed 2% of current phase balance.
challenge_simulator.marking: M5 intraday low/high extrema and last pre-exit close mark open positions; same-bar exit is after entry/marks and stop-first ordering is conservative. DLL includes marked floating PnL; MLL is a static 10% floor. Five distinct server-day trade closures required in each phase.
challenge_simulator.server_day: Europe/Helsinki seasonal GMT+2/GMT+3 proxy; verify against funded account server.
limitations: Quarter cohorts are synchronized across instruments to preserve observed cross-index co-occurrence, but a trade's marked path is shifted as a unit with its entry quarter.
This is a bootstrap simulation of observed trade cohorts, not a future-price guarantee or a full broker/platform execution emulator.
